title: Avalanche incident (GeoJSON Feature)
description: One reported avalanche accident in data/incidents/incidents.geojson, written only by pipeline/incidents/import_incidents.py from an authorized source file. Observed history, never a hazard rating; absence of incidents never implies low risk.

geometry.description: Point at the published coordinates, or null when the source gives none. Coordinates are never geocoded or inferred from a place description.

id.description: Stable internal id: <source>:<upstreamId>, or <source>:<date>:<hash> when the source has no event id.

upstreamId.description: Source event id as published (for example a CAIC report UUID); null when the source has none.

sourceUrl.description: Official report page for this incident, when known.

date.description: Local calendar date of the accident (America/Denver) as reported.

season.description: Avalanche year, October 1 to September 30, e.g. 2024-2025.

place.description: Place name as reported (untrusted text; escape when rendering).

meaning.description: What the point represents according to the source; 'unknown' when the source does not say; 'none' when geometry is null.

uncertaintyM.description: Horizontal uncertainty in metres if the source states one; null if not stated.

activity.description: Activity or travel mode, source wording kept.

summary.description: Source summary text, only with permission to reproduce it (untrusted; escape when rendering).

verifiedFacts.description: Short factual statements checked against the official report.
